description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of various models on three evaluation metrics—Sentiment Accuracy (Sentiment Acc.), STS Correlation (STS Corr.), and Paraphrase Accuracy (Paraphrase Acc.)—across five different configurations: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and a final model labeled with a gray bar. The vertical axis represents the accuracy or correlation values, ranging from 0 to 0.8, with a gridline at every 0.2 increment. The horizontal axis lists the model configurations. For each configuration, three bars are displayed side-by-side, with the Sentiment Acc. represented by a light yellow bar, STS Corr. by a pink bar, and Paraphrase Acc. by a light blue bar. The chart shows that the Supervised_SimCSE model achieves the highest values across all three metrics, with the STS Corr. reaching approximately 0.82, Paraphrase Acc. around 0.79, and Sentiment Acc. at about 0.52. The Unsupervised_SimCSE model performs well, particularly in STS Corr. (around 0.74) and Paraphrase Acc. (around 0.78), while the Single-task_baseline model shows the lowest performance, with Sentiment Acc. at about 0.55, STS Corr. at about 0.53, and Paraphrase Acc. at about 0.80. The Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout model shows moderate performance, with Sentiment Acc. at about 0.55, STS Corr. at about 0.59, and Paraphrase Acc. at about 0.79. The final model, represented by the gray bar, shows high performance in all metrics, with Sentiment Acc. at about 0.53, STS Corr. at about 0.82, and Paraphrase Acc. at about 0.79.
